tools.name: check_warranty
tools.description: Look up a brand's standard manufacturer warranty for the US: coverage length (only when the brand's page states it), what it excludes, and where to claim. Optional purchase_date places the term on a calendar. Mints a public TRACE receipt. Not store return windows.

tools.name: get_warranty_receipt
tools.description: Fetch a public Warranty Desk TRACE receipt by id (wdr_...).
